text:
kevin: Who is flipping canary -> prod at 15:30 PT? I'll be oncall for the window.

sara: That's me. Pushing release/rls-2026-03-17 to prod at :30. mike and denise on standby.

mike: Watching deploy logs. CI passed on canary at 15:10. ops-bot will post rollout updates.

ops-bot: deploy: started rollout for release/rls-2026-03-17 -> prod (slice 1/5). link: https://ci.redwood/release/253333

denise: Post-flip sanity plan: quick health, trace-check, latency gauge, embed hit test. Running smoke script after slice fully active.

alex: I pushed a tiny fix to the healthcheck threshold on staging. QA ran 100 queries — all good.

tasha: Rollback plan: branch hotfix/rls-2026-03-17-rollback ready. Rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --release rls-2026-03-17 --to-tag canary
```
I'll be ready in case.

mike: Slice 1 green. no errors. perf: p50 ~ 82ms, p95 ~ 310ms (expected).

denise: Kicking off verification checklist now. running:
- curl /health
- /metrics top token-rate
- run small prompt set (3 in 10s)
I'll paste results.

denise: health: 200 OK
metrics: token-rate nominal
prompt smoke: all responses non-empty, no obvious regressions

sara: :thumbsup: proceeding to slice 2 -> deploy

ci-bot: pipeline: slice 2 completed successfully. canary -> prod slice 2/5

mike: Monitoring for 5m window; setting alert watch: latency + error rate

kevin: If anything spikes call me. Otherwise we'll finish rollout and do a final pulse at 16:15 PT.

denise: Final pulse notes: small uptick in embeddings request retries in eu-west-1 (2->5 per min) — watched, seemed tied to infra flapper, auto-recovered. No user impact.

sara: Rollout complete 5/5. Post-release checklist: metrics for 30m, run smoke again at half hour, tag release 'deployed/2026-03-17'.

mike: Tag pushed. I'm adding a quick blurb to release notes and will follow up with perf numbers in #eng-releases.

kevin: Thanks team. I'll mark SLO watch as normal. Closing this thread — ping if we need to roll back.
